info.name: Medical API (Organized)
info.description: Organized Postman collection grouped by modules with clear request docs. Base prefix: /api/v1.

item.name: Auth Module
item.description: Authentication endpoints including login, OAuth, logout, and token flows.

item.name: User login — obtains access token using credentials

request.description:
Login a user and issue tokens.

Authentication: Public (no token required).
Request Body:
- email (string, required)
- password (string, required)

Success 200: Returns accessToken, refreshToken, and user profile.
Errors: 400 invalid credentials, 429 too many attempts.

item.description:
Purpose: User login — obtains access token using credentials
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/login
Notes: Provide email and password to receive access/refresh tokens.

item.name: Google OAuth login — redirect with profile/email scopes

request.description:
Start Google OAuth login.

Authentication: Public.
Behavior: Redirects to Google consent screen with email/profile scopes.
On success: Google will call the callback endpoint to finalize login.

item.description:
Purpose: Google OAuth login — redirect to Google
Method: GET
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/google
Notes: Starts OAuth flow; no auth needed.

item.name: Google OAuth callback — handle sign-in after Google returns

request.description:
Handle Google OAuth callback and finalize sign‑in.

Authentication: Public; invoked by Google.
Behavior: Exchanges Google code for tokens and creates/returns user session.
Success 200: Returns accessToken, refreshToken, and user.

item.description:
Purpose: Google OAuth callback — completes OAuth
Method: GET
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/google/callback
Notes: Returns tokens/user; called by Google after consent.

item.name: User logout — invalidate active sessions/tokens

request.description:
Logout current user and invalidate tokens.

Authentication: Bearer token required.
Behavior: Revokes active session (access/refresh tokens).
Success 200: Confirmation message.

item.description:
Purpose: User logout — invalidate tokens
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/logout
Notes: Requires auth; clears session.

item.name: Password reset request — send reset link via email

request.description:
Request a password reset link via email.

Authentication: Public.
Request Body: email (string, required).
Success 200: Reset email sent if account exists.
Notes: Response is generic to avoid email enumeration.

item.description:
Purpose: Password reset request — sends link
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/forget-password
Notes: Initiates reset flow via email.

item.name: Email verification — verify via code/token

request.description:
Verify email using OTP or token.

Authentication: Public.
Request Body: email (string), oneTimeCode (number) or token (string).
Success 200: Email marked verified; user can log in normally.

item.description:
Purpose: Email verification — code/token verify
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/verify-email
Notes: Provide email and OTP or token.

item.name: Password reset — set new password with valid token

request.description:
Reset password using a valid reset token.

Authentication: Public (token-based).
Request Body:
- token (string, required)
- newPassword (string, required)
Success 200: Password updated; old tokens become invalid.

item.description:
Purpose: Password reset — set new password
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/reset-password
Notes: Use valid reset token.

item.name: Change password — authenticated user provides old/new password

request.description:
Change current user password.

Authentication: Bearer token required.
Request Body:
- oldPassword (string)
- newPassword (string, must meet security rules)
Success 200: Password changed; re‑authenticate recommended.

item.description:
Purpose: Change password — authenticated
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/change-password
Notes: Requires auth; provide old/new passwords.

item.name: Resend verification email

request.description:
Resend email verification message.

Authentication: Public.
Request Body: email (string).
Success 200: Verification email queued if account needs verification.

item.description:
Purpose: Resend verification email
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/resend-verify-email
Notes: Resends verification email.

item.name: Refresh token — renew access token

request.description:
Exchange refresh token for a new access token.

Authentication: Refresh token (cookie/body).
Success 200: Returns fresh accessToken.
Notes: If refresh token is invalid/expired, returns 401.

item.description:
Purpose: Refresh token — renew access token
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/auth/refresh-token
Notes: Uses refresh token (cookie/body).

item.name: User Module
item.description: User profile and admin user management endpoints.

item.name: Create new user — validation + rate limit

request.description:
Register a new user account.

Authentication: Public.
Request Body: name, email, password.
Validation: Email uniqueness; password strength policy.
Rate limiting: Enabled to prevent abuse.
Success 201: Returns created user (without password).

item.description:
Purpose: Create user
Method: POST
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/user/
Notes: Validates payload; rate limited.

item.name: Fetch own profile details

request.description:
Get the currently authenticated user’s profile.

Authentication: Bearer token required (any role).
Success 200: Returns user details and settings.

item.description:
Purpose: Get user profile
Method: GET
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/user/profile
Notes: Requires auth; returns current user.

item.name: Update own profile — file upload + validation

request.description:
Update current user profile and optional file uploads.

Authentication: Bearer token required.
Content‑Type: multipart/form‑data (for files).
Editable fields may include name, avatar, preferences.
Success 200: Returns updated user.

item.description:
Purpose: Update user profile
Method: PATCH
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/user/profile
Notes: Upload fields like profilePicture; requires auth.

item.name: List all users — super admin only

request.description:
List all users (admin only).

Authentication: Bearer token with SUPER_ADMIN role.
Query: pagination/filter may apply.
Success 200: Paginated list of users.

item.description:
Purpose: List users (admin)
Method: GET
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/user/
Notes: Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.

item.name: Block user — super admin

request.description:
Block a user by ID (admin).

Authentication: SUPER_ADMIN required.
Path: :id — target user ID.
Success 200: User status set to blocked; access revoked.

item.description:
Purpose: Block user
Method: PATCH
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/user/:id/block
Notes: Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.

item.name: Unblock user — super admin

request.description:
Unblock a user by ID (admin).

Authentication: SUPER_ADMIN required.
Path: :id — target user ID.
Success 200: User status set to active.

item.description:
Purpose: Unblock user
Method: PATCH
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/user/:id/unblock
Notes: Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.

item.name: Get specific user details by ID (super admin)

request.description:
Get a specific user by ID (admin).

Authentication: SUPER_ADMIN required.
Path: :id — target user ID.
Success 200: Returns user details.

item.description:
Purpose: Get user by ID
Method: GET
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/user/:id
Notes: Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.

item.name: Public user details (guest allowed) — rate limited

request.description:
Fetch public‑safe details for a user by ID.

Authentication: Guest allowed.
Path: :id — target user ID.
Rate limiting: Enabled.
Success 200: Returns non‑sensitive profile fields.

item.description:
Purpose: Public user details
Method: GET
URL: {{BASE_URL}}/api/v1/user/:id/user
Notes: Guest access; rate limited.
